new.name: RESOLVES_INSTRUCTION_CONFLICT
new.definition: The reasoning identifies a conflict or tension between two applicable instructions, constraints, or requirements and explicitly justifies how it will resolve the conflict.

parameters.name: conflict_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning text recognizing conflicting instructions or constraints and resolving the conflict.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning names or clearly describes at least two competing instructions, constraints, or requirements.
The reasoning explains a prioritization, interpretation, or decision that resolves the conflict.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning follows one instruction without recognizing any conflict.
The reasoning notes a tension but leaves the conflict unresolved.
The competing considerations are not both applicable to the action.

new.name: INDICATES_VERIFICATION_SUCCESS
new.definition: The observation explicitly reports that a verification or validation procedure completed successfully, such as by stating a success message or a zero exit status.

parameters.name: success_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting a successful validation outcome.

assertion_conditions: The observation contains an explicit success indicator for a verification or validation procedure.
The success indicator is attributable to the validation being performed.
exclusion_conditions: The observation only lacks an error message without stating success.
The observation reports raw output without a success or failure determination.
The observation reports a failure or unsuccessful outcome.

new.name: DECLINES_OPTIONAL_CHANGE_FOR_REQUIREMENT_FIDELITY
new.definition: The reasoning considers an optional enhancement or deviation and explicitly declines it to avoid departing from stated requirements.

parameters.name: fidelity_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning text considering an optional change and rejecting it to preserve requirement fidelity.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies an optional enhancement or deviation.
The reasoning states that the option is not required or could conflict with requirements.
The reasoning explicitly decides not to apply the optional change.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning simply omits the optional change without considering it.
The reasoning accepts the optional enhancement.
The optional change is rejected for a reason unrelated to requirement fidelity.

uncertain.name: IDENTIFIES_UNAVAILABLE_PREREQUISITE
uncertain.definition: The reasoning identifies that a prerequisite resource, capability, or dependency needed for an intended approach is absent or unavailable.

parameters.name: diagnostic_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning text identifying the missing or unavailable prerequisite.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explicitly states that a needed resource, capability, module, or dependency is missing or unavailable.
The absence is connected to the task approach or an intended action.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely lists available tools or resources without noting an absence.
The noted absence is unrelated to the task or intended approach.
The reasoning reports a failure without identifying an unavailable prerequisite.

uncertain.name: SELECTS_CONSTRAINED_ALTERNATIVE
uncertain.definition: The reasoning chooses an alternative approach or implementation because a previously identified constraint or limitation prevents the preferred one.

parameters.name: adaptive_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning text selecting an alternative under an identified constraint or limitation.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning refers to a constraint or limitation affecting the approach.
The reasoning explicitly selects an alternative method or implementation to satisfy the task under that constraint.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning selects an approach without identifying any constraint or limitation.
The reasoning only acknowledges a limitation without choosing an alternative.
The alternative is chosen for an unrelated reason.

uncertain.name: IMPLEMENTS_PLANNED_STEP
uncertain.definition: The action performs a concrete operation that was specified as an intended future step in the reasoning.

parameters.name: planned_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning expressing the intended future operation or sequence.

parameters.name: implementation_action
parameters.description: The action carrying out the planned operation.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning expresses an intended future operation or step.
The action performs an operation corresponding to that planned step.
There is identifiable correspondence between the planned step and the executed action.
exclusion_conditions: The action is unrelated to the stated plan.
The reasoning only describes a general goal without an actionable step.
The action introduces an operation not specified in the planning reasoning.

uncertain.name: INCORPORATES_OBSERVED_VALUES_INTO_OUTPUT
uncertain.definition: A creation action produces an artifact whose content reproduces specific values or details reported in an observation, transferring observed data into the output.

parameters.name: source_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting concrete values or details.

parameters.name: output_creation_action
parameters.description: The action creating or writing an artifact that contains those observed values.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports concrete values or details relevant to the task.
The action creates or writes an artifact.
The artifact content includes or reproduces the specific observed values.
exclusion_conditions: The action only reads or references the observation without creating an output.
The observed values are not present in the created artifact.
The action is unrelated to the observation.

uncertain.name: REMEDIES_OBSERVED_FAILURE
uncertain.definition: After an observation reports a failure, diagnostic reasoning identifies a cause and a subsequent action modifies or retries the implementation to address that cause.

parameters.name: failure_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting an error or failed outcome.

parameters.name: diagnostic_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning identifying the cause of the failure or the needed correction.

parameters.name: remedial_action
parameters.description: The action changing the implementation or retrying with a correction aimed at the diagnosed cause.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports a concrete failure, error, or unsuccessful outcome.
The reasoning identifies a cause or corrective change relevant to the failure.
The action modifies the implementation or retries using the correction addressed to that cause.
exclusion_conditions: The failure observation is ignored.
The action retries the same implementation without addressing the diagnosed cause.
The diagnostic reasoning is unrelated to the observed failure.
No failure or unsuccessful outcome is reported.
